Not present in the repo: .brace/ (no deployment.yaml or record), CI workflows, tests, IaC for IAM/Redis/Postgres/Qdrant, admission policies, branch protection, runbooks, incident or eval records, lockfiles for the npx MCP servers. Not reviewed: the code of the three npx MCP servers, the Postgres schema and grants, cluster settings, provider contracts.
